videos.title: The Library of Babel Bleeds Crimson | ASCII Space Dub #shorts
videos.description:
An endless library sinks one more floor and its indigo light begins to turn crimson.

A 3-minute moment from "Library of Babel," a 2-hour ambient space dub visualizer. Binaural movement, deep dub tape delays, no words. Best with headphones.

Visuals coded in HTML, recorded and rendered by Seiler Asterces.
Music composed and performed by Secrets Are Lies in Logic Pro.

videos.title: Library of Babel | 2 Hour Ambient Space Dub Visualizer | Endless ASCII Galleries
videos.description:
An endless library of hexagonal galleries drawn entirely in characters. Glyphs resolve into pages, hold, and dissolve as the view drifts and descends, floor after floor, through six colours to the Total Book.

Chapters
0:00 Amber Galleries
7:00 First Descent
20:00 Verdigris: Mirror Pages
40:00 Indigo: Glyph Rain
1:00:00 Crimson
1:20:00 Silver
1:40:00 Gold
1:56:00 The Total Book
1:58:00 The Library

videos.title: Saturn, the Moon & the Northern Cross in One Sky | Ambient Space Dub
videos.description:
One slow pan across the night sky on November 17, 2026: the first quarter Moon through the trees, the Northern Cross (Cygnus) setting in the west, and Saturn shining above Diphda in Cetus to the south.

Stars labeled: Deneb, Sadr, Aljanah, Albireo, Diphda. The bright one in the south is not a star at all. It's Saturn.

Filmed on iPhone by Seiler Asterces.
